lines.text: LINK is down 1.9% — and it’s trending on CoinGecko at #10.

lines.text: Chainlink is a decentralized oracle network that connects blockchains to real-world data.

lines.text: Its hybrid smart contracts use off-chain computation for faster, cheaper transactions.
